plan: With a private value of $40, I want to maximize my potential profit. In a first-price sealed bid auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically below my true value. Since the value is independently drawn each round, I'll bid close to my true value but slightly under - around $39 - to leave some potential profit margin if I win.

In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the dominant strategy is to bid truthfully up to my private value. Since my value is $42, I want to maximize my potential profit. The optimal bid will be just above what I expect other rational bidders might bid, but not exceeding my true value. I'll bid close to, but slightly under my true value to ensure potential profit if I win.

In a first-price sealed bid auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Since my private value is $28, I want to maximize potential profit. Given the $0-$20 typical range for other bidders, I'll bid strategically to increase my chances of winning while preserving profit margin. I'll bid close to, but not exactly at, my true value to create a buffer.
